subject: economics
title: Externalities
welcome_lead: Markets miss the costs and benefits felt by third parties.
meta_desc: A-Level Market Failure: positive and negative externalities.
final_note: Markets ignore third-party effects - that is the textbook market failure.

concepts.def: Cost or benefit affecting a third party.
Marginal private cost plus external cost.
Marginal private benefit plus external benefit.
Welfare loss from over- or under-production.

walkthroughs.body_html: A pollutant harms neighbours who never bought the good - that is a negative externality. A vaccine protects others - a positive externality. Either way the market price ignores them.
With a negative externality, MSC exceeds MPC and the market overproduces. With a positive externality, MSB exceeds MPB and the market underproduces.
Taxes (Pigouvian) shift MPC up to MSC. Subsidies shift MPB up to MSB. Tradable permits cap quantity. Property rights (Coase) let parties bargain.
